messages:
alex: I'm taking evening primary now (18:00 PT). Quick snapshot: KV cache thrash in us-west-2 causing ~8% 5xxs on /v1/generate for a subset of Dedicated tenants. Latency up ~200ms on average. Leaving notes + immediate steps below.

incident-bot: Pager: HIGH_ERROR_RATE triggered 20m ago (alert id: A-7842). Pages sent to @primary, @secondary.

maria: acknowledged, I'm on secondary. i'll watch for noisy clients and start collecting traces.

alex: main quick checks (do these first):
1) check runtime pod errors
2) confirm KV cache eviction spikes
3) put fallback routing on for heavy tenants if error rate doesn't drop

alex: kubectl snippets -- run from infra jumpbox:
```
# check pods and recent restarts
kubectl -n redwood-inference get pods -l app=runtime -o wide
kubectl -n redwood-inference logs $(kubectl -n redwood-inference get pod -l app=runtime -o name | head -n1) --tail=200

# check autoscaler events
kubectl -n redwood-inference get hpa -o yaml | egrep -A3 "name: runtime"
```

jamal: if pods look healthy but errors persist, check KV metrics: `redis-latency-ms`, `cache-hit-rate`. evictions spiking usually from malformed prefixes or a large fanout job.

alex: runbook links: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kvcache-thrash (KV cache thrash playbook) and https://redwood.internal/runbooks/high-5xx-rate (5xx triage). ops-bot will post a condensed checklist.

ops-bot: Condensed checklist posted to thread: 1) Verify pod health + restart single affected pod; 2) Toggle per-tenant fallback routing; 3) Increase cache size/eviction threshold temporarily; 4) If noisy keyspace, apply keyspace limiter policy.

maria: i'm running the redis metrics query now. if we see >50% eviction rate for any shard -> bump eviction threshold and throttle the largest client.

lee: leaving a command for fallback routing via control-plane API (use support token):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://control-plane.redwood.internal/v1/routing/overrides"
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SUPPORT_TOKEN"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"tenant_id":"tenant-88","route":"model-small-v2","reason":"auto-fallback kv-eviction"}'
```

alex: immediate mitigation I did: restarted runtime pod `runtime-5b7f` in us-west-2 (roll restart single pod). error rate dropped a bit, but still above threshold for tenant-88.

jamal: good. next escalation: if error rate >10% for >15m after mitigations, page L2 (oncall-sre). Also start a quick sampling eval against the fallback model to make sure quality okay.

maria: sampling done for tenant-88 fallback, results look acceptable for 95% of requests. I'll leave the override for 30m and monitor.

alex: tickets / handoff notes: creating INC-4321 on the ops board with links + actions. leave all console changes in the ticket comments.

lee: FYI: if you need to scale cache, use the infra playbook link: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/cache-scale-guidance and coordinate with infra. scaling has a ~10-15m window.

alex: runbook quick commands for common remediations (paste into terminal):
```
# quick restart one runtime pod (safer than full rollout)
kubectl -n redwood-inference delete pod runtime-5b7f

# reduce client qps for tenant (via quota API)
curl -X POST "https://control-plane.redwood.internal/v1/quotas/tenant-88" -d '{"qps":50}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $SUPPORT_TOKEN"
```

maria: confirming I'll stay secondary until 21:30 PT, will escalate if noise resurges.

jamal: add this to morning handoff: note the fallback override, recent restart, and eviction metrics. if latency falls back below SLO and 5xxs <1% for 30m, we can revert fallback.

alex: agreed. final handoff checklist for next oncall: 1) check INC-4321 ticket comments, 2) verify `kv-eviction-rate` per-shard, 3) confirm override TTLs and remove if stable, 4) review client throttle metrics.

lee: leaving a short note in the ticket with the exact commands we ran.

incident-bot: Pager resolved (A-7842) at 18:30 PT - error rate trend decreasing but still on watch.

alex: thanks team. passing primary to maria at 18:45 PT, leaving console notes and ticket updates. ping me if anything noisy. :thumbsup:

maria: got it, taking primary. I'll update last status in INC-4321 and post a morning summary.

lee: morning handoff owners, please check runbooks linked above.

jamal: ping if L2 is needed. signing off for L1 oversight.
